category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in New Zealand.
subcategory_description: The minimum pay and leave that employees are entitled to.
label: Adult minimum wage per hour
context: Before tax. Applies to employees aged 16 or over who are not on the starting-out or training rate. There is no minimum wage for employees under 16.

label: Adult minimum wage for a 40-hour week
context: Before tax. The adult hourly rate for 40 hours.

label: Starting-out minimum wage per hour
context: Before tax. Can be paid in the situations the source lists, such as to a 16 or 17 year old in their first 6 continuous months with one employer. The adult rate applies after that.

label: Training minimum wage per hour
context: Before tax. Can be paid to an employee aged 20 or over whose employment agreement requires at least 60 credits a year of an industry training programme. It usually applies to apprentices.

subject_intro: The three minimum wage rates for employees in New Zealand, who each rate applies to, who is not covered, and how to check you are being paid at least the minimum.
subject_meta_description: The adult minimum wage is {fact:nz_mw_adult} an hour before tax. See who can be paid the lower starting-out and training rates, and who is not covered.
